description: Keep terminal per-file outcomes and readable failure reasons visible after a failed or partially successful batch.
Show one batch failure toast without duplicating existing permission notifications.
Explain drops with no File objects and avoid invoking upload or folder selection.
Return a deterministic batch summary and finalize uploading state after all attempts.
Refresh successful documents and close both Documents upload instances only after a fully successful batch.
Keep project task uploads open on failure while preserving per-file successful additions.
Prevent overlapping batches and allow same-file reselection after completion without automatic retry.
Preserve folder selection and previous outcomes when folder selection is canceled.
Keep successful upload outcomes distinct from callback or refresh failures.
Provide translated, accessible feedback using existing theme and notification conventions.
